cc:Work.dc:title: FlexBox - FlexBox5Plus
cc:Work.dc:description:
Box with living hinge and round corners, with optional turning latch and inner reinforcements
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes FlexBox5Plus --x=140 --h=100 --outside=1 --top_diameter=50 --bottom_diameter=70 --reinforcements=2 --reinforcement_width=8 --turn_latch=1 --format=svg Command line short: boxes FlexBox5Plus --x=140 --top_diameter=50 --bottom_diameter=70 --reinforcements=2 --reinforcement_width=8 --turn_latch=1
